question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Either of them have started the protest outside my house.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is** the subject-verb agreement.**
 
• **"Either"** is a singular subject and should be followed by** a singular verb.**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "Either of them has"**, ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Either of them has started the protest outside my house."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1) No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **2) started the protest** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3) outside my house.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
